name: Survivor arm
description: One stubby arm of a survivor, hinged at the shoulder: origin at the joint, limb hanging down +y. A short bare arm in skin with a round mitten of a hand, no fingers — at two heads tall a hand is a circle, and a circle is what a plush toy has. `far` is the arm behind the body, in shade.

far.description: The arm behind the body, in shade.
